Photography Mentoring in Budapest

master studio photography with our 1-on-1 mentoring packages in our photo studio

At Aether Art Space, our Photography Mentoring program guides you from beginner to confident studio photographer—digital or analogue. Whether you want to master lighting in the studio, direct models, develop film, or perfect post-processing, we’ll walk you through everything step by step in an immersive, hands-on environment designed to accelerate your growth.

Photographer Mentoring Packages from 99.000.HUF

professional mentors

Digital Photography Mentoring Package

If you want to be a confident studio photographer who can handle the entire process of digital photography from beginning to end, this package is for you.

99.000. HUF for 3+1 lessons

The package includes everything you need to complete the course:

  • camera, laptop and software if needed
  • model fee
  • studio rent

Lesson #1 - Studio Basics and Ground Work

  • How to use the strobes and a digital camera in a studio setting confidently.
  • How to prepare everything for your photoshoot in Lesson #2

Lesson #2 - Photoshoot with a pro model

  • How to handle light and adapt it for different poses
  • How to instruct the model
  • How to experiment and pivot live

Lesson #3 - Post-processing and retouching

  • How to select your final set of images
  • Post-processing in Adobe Lightroom
  • High-end retouching in Adobe Photoshop

+1 - 2 hours for free in the studio

You can do your first shoot alone - we will be in the next room if you need help.

Analogue Photography Mentoring Package

If you want to learn how to shoot with film and also develop, scan and post-process the images through a real photoshoot with a professional model, this package is for you.

99.000. HUF for 3 lessons

The package includes everything you need to complete the course:

  • camera, laptop and software if needed
  • chemicals and equipment for developing film
  • model fee
  • studio rent

Lesson #1 - Studio Basics and Ground Work

  • How to use the strobes and a film camera in a studio setting confidently.
  • How to prepare everything for your photoshoot in Lesson #2
  • How to select a film suitable for your shoot

Lesson #2 - Photoshoot with a pro model

  • How to handle light and adapt it for different poses
  • How to instruct the model
  • How to experiment and pivot live

Lesson #3 - Developing and post-processing

  • How to develop black and white film
  • How to scan film
  • How to invert negatives and post-process the images

+1 - 2 hours for free in the studio

You can do your first shoot alone - we will be in the next room if you need help.
